name: Minimal
description: Radical reduction, refined typographic hierarchy, quiet monochromatic palette, and supreme reliance on breath and whitespace.
designPrinciples: Subtractive clarity: eliminate any element that does not convey meaning
Extreme economy of line, color, and texture
Generous expanse of negative space that commands focus
Restrained micro-accent color used sparingly for focal contrast

guidelines: Moderate contrast between heading and body
Generous letter-spacing on small uppercase metadata tags
Keep text density light and scannable

layout.structure: Single-axis centered or elegant left-aligned stack with vast breathing room
layout.spacing: Vast margins (64px+) and uncrowded vertical flow
layout.alignment: Strict vertical axis alignment with subtle horizontal groupings
rules: Never crowd containers; maintain generous inner padding (at least 48px)
Rely on subtle font weight and color step-down rather than boxes or lines
Keep total distinct visual elements below 6

patternsToAvoid: Dense walls of text or tight element grids
